observations.scope: Byte-identical packaged runtime registers the native CustomDocument provider with multiple-view support in the isolated developer profile.
Actual open command produces TabInputCustom and masked native HTML without opening any original TextDocument.
Scripted native confirmation gates one-field payload; real ten-second hiding and all-value safe-reader masking hold.
Native split creates two custom tabs sharing one CustomDocument, and only the initiating real panel receives a revealed value.
Private password edit emits a real custom edit event; native Undo/Redo/Save preserve unrelated bytes and clean the saved custom tab.
Native close/reopen retains the saved private value while default panels and original TextDocument count remain masked/zero.
Actual workbench backup for the final dirty revision produces issued authenticated ciphertext, with native SecretStorage calls and hot-exit enabled.

identityScope: Byte-identical packaged runtime, actual persistent developer context, native CustomDocument/WebviewPanel/TabInputCustom/workbench operations. Not clean-profile install proof.
interactionScope: Actual registered native-panel listener and native modal/password API arguments with scripted same-instance owner decisions; no browser DOM automation or human owner-presence proof.
recoveryScope: Save phase observes actual workbench backup; reload independently requires workbench-supplied issued backupId. Final closing backup may be generated after the save-phase probe. No manual-provider backup/restoration fallback is counted as native recovery.
custodyScope: Synthetic isolated native SecretStorage store/get use; not independent OS custody certification.
